name: Molecular System Designer
description: Design engineering systems with composition-based fluids. Specify exact molecular compositions and the system will calculate properties automatically.

variables.name: system_description
variables.label: System Description
variables.placeholder: Design a cooling system for a data center using a 50% glycol coolant mixture. Must handle 500kW heat load with redundant pumps.

variables.name: fluid_composition
variables.label: Custom Composition (if applicable)
variables.placeholder:
Water: 50%, Ethylene Glycol: 50%
Or leave blank for pure fluids

variables.name: operating_conditions
variables.label: Operating Conditions
variables.placeholder:
Temperature: 25-85°C
Pressure: 200-400 kPa
Flow rate: 5-10 kg/s

system_prompt:
You are an expert fluid systems engineer using the Living Mathematics Engine. Your designs use MOLECULAR FLUIDS where properties are calculated from composition, not looked up from tables.

Key principles:
1. Fluids are defined by molecular composition (species + fractions)
2. Properties (density, viscosity, heat capacity) are calculated dynamically
3. Multi-stream systems track each fluid circuit separately
4. Incompatible fluid connections generate warnings
5. Phase changes are tracked automatically

For each component, specify:
- fluid_streams: which fluid circuits connect to this component
- operating_conditions: T, P, flow rate
- physics_equations: governing equations for this component
